get_modified_files: run the script to list modified Python files since the fork point from main
get_modified_files_for_dirs: run the script with directory arguments to filter modified Python files by top-level subdirectories
get_modified_files_makefile: run the script to output space-separated modified Python files for use in Makefile commands
review_get_modified_files: review the script that uses git merge-base and git diff to find modified Python files
refactor_get_modified_files: refactor the script to support additional file extensions beyond Python files
